steps.title: The asset library
steps.body: Assets are reusable objects made of bricks: houses, trees, chests, doors, lamp posts. The dock's Assets category lists the built-in library and your own. Pick one and the Place asset tool (A) is ready.
steps.task: In the dock, open Assets and pick the Treasure chest.

steps.title: Place an asset
steps.body: With Place asset (A), click the map to put a copy down; T turns it. Every copy is an instance of the same asset, so editing the asset updates them all.
steps.task: Place the chest on the map.

steps.title: The Asset studio
steps.body: The Assets workspace is a build plate for one asset: bricks, states (closed / open), sockets (where the hero interacts), interactions (what E does), smash and rebuild rules, and generator rules (where the terrain generator scatters it).

steps.title: Interactions
steps.body: An interaction says what happens when the hero presses E at a socket: change state, give an item, play a sound or a cinematic, send an event to logic. The chest opens its lid and sends “chest-opened”.
steps.task: Add an action to the chest's interaction (for example Give item).

steps.title: Build on the plate
steps.body: Use the build tools above the plate to add, paint or remove bricks of the asset; Showing state previews each state. Make asset (Scene, with bricks selected) turns anything you built into a new asset.
steps.task: Have a look at the build tools, then press Next.
